name: PromptInput
intent: Composable AI prompt input — an auto-sizing textarea with attachment and submit affordances — for sending messages to an assistant.
when: The text entry for an AI chat or command surface

chooseOver.because: Textarea is a plain form control; PromptInput adds send/attachment affordances for AI input

extracted: cva variants/sizes remain generated by the structural extractor

lineage.confidence: unset — projection round-trip verified; no held-out eval yet

props.name: submitting
props.description: Response generation is in progress. Keeps the textarea editable while disabling the send action.

props.name: attachments
props.description: Attachments displayed as removable chips/cards above the textarea.

props.name: availableContext
props.description: When provided, shows an "Add context" button that opens a popover with these items.

props.name: acceptFileTypes
props.description: File types accepted by the upload input (e.g. ".pdf,.png").

props.name: multipleFiles
props.description: Allow multiple file selection. Defaults to true.

props.name: addActions
props.description: Extra actions in the `+` menu, after "Upload file".

props.name: tools
props.description: Tools shown in the Tools menu. Active ones render as removable pills in the toolbar.

props.name: models
props.description: Selectable models. Shows a model-picker button on the right when provided.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Quick-action pills rendered in a row below the composer.

props.name: trailingActions
props.description: Extra slots rendered just before the model selector (legacy escape hatch).

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Min/max textarea heights in pixels. Defaults: 88 (≈3 lines) / 198.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child element, merging props and behavior.

usage: Use PromptInput when you need to collect user input or allow users to make selections. This component provides a consistent interaction pattern that users will find familiar and accessible.

PromptInput should be used within forms or interactive interfaces where user data collection is required. Ensure proper labeling and validation feedback for accessibility. Avoid using this component for read-only or display-only content.

anatomy.description: PromptInput is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Always include labels
bestPractices.description: Every input should have an associated label for accessibility.

bestPractices.title: Don't rely on placeholders alone
bestPractices.description: Placeholders disappear when typing and shouldn't replace labels.

bestPractices.title: Show validation feedback
bestPractices.description: Display clear error messages near the input when validation fails.

bestPractices.title: Don't delay error feedback
bestPractices.description: Show validation errors immediately, don't wait until form submission.

bestPractices.title: Use appropriate input types
bestPractices.description: Use specialized input types (email, tel, number) for better mobile keyboards.

bestPractices.title: Don't use text type for everything
bestPractices.description: Avoid using generic text inputs when a specialized type exists.
